description: Greening Boston: The Climate Change Preparedness and Resiliency Checklist is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Boston Planning & Development Agency; City of Boston Environment Department. To build the city's resilience, Boston requires that new buildings and renovation projects follow best practices for climate change adaptation. Coverage: the United States (2017). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
